brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres, dampers, and the airflow path for Ivybridge Green (SUB-SGW-340) in accordance with SOP-015, clearing any obstruction above one quarter of the free area before the forecast heat event. If this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure as directed by MG-023. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period per MG-021.
